component.name: Tubeless
component.summary: Ad-free video player with or without a Google account

description.p: Tubeless plays YouTube without ads, signed in with your Google account or without one. Signed out, your subscriptions, history, playlists and recommendations stay on your computer.

ul.li: Subscriptions, Watch later, playlists and history, imported from Google Takeout or NewPipe if you like
Recommendations made on your device from what you watch
SponsorBlock, Return YouTube Dislike and DeArrow
Captions, chapters, a video queue and audio-only playback
Videos saved to watch without internet
Optionally synced with your YouTube account, or none at all
